headline: Profit surges year over year, eases from prior quarter
summary_short: Revenue of $3,104M was down 4.1% q/q but up 27.0% y/y; net income of $1,002M fell 21.8% q/q while still up 49.8% y/y off a much weaker year-ago base.
summary_long: Revenue was $3,104M, down 4.1% q/q but up 27.0% y/y. Gross profit of $1,703M fell 12.4% q/q yet rose 42.3% y/y; operating income of $1,583M fell 12.7% q/q but rose 58.5% y/y. EBIT/EBITDA of $1,698M were down 16.7% q/q and up 55.8% y/y. Net income of $1,002M eased 21.8% q/q but climbed 49.8% y/y. EPS was $1.97 (diluted $1.96), down roughly 22% q/q and up roughly 49% y/y. No cash-position figure is present on the shard.
